Addendum 2026-10-15T04:55Z by the filing seat (`session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP`, os-bill), two maintainer follow-ups in the same chat, verbatim: 「之前 pin 是左侧菜单划过的实现显示，你的意思是去掉，换到右上角的下拉菜单？」 and 「如果两个概念合并，那叫收藏是不是更好」, plus a proposal: 「是否建议类似 Claude code，左侧菜单划过时，加上下拉，很多功能可以放进去。比如设计对象等。」

**Naming (replaces "Pinned" wherever this card says it).** The merged section at the top of the app sidebar is called **Favorites** (zh-CN 收藏), with the star icon; the sidebar label "Pinned" is retired. Reasons: the store is already `favorites`, the i18n keys `common.addToFavorites` / `common.removeFromFavorites` and `sidebar.favorites` already exist in all ten packs, the Home page and the console-home sidebar already call the same items favorites, and "pin" describes a position while this feature is a personal collection that happens to be shown at the top (Notion and Linear name the same section Favorites). `type: 'nav'` stays an internal storage detail; nothing in the store changes. The sidebar's hover control therefore becomes a star, not a pin icon, and the page overflow entry reads "Add to favorites" / "Remove from favorites".

**Where the control lives (answering the first question).** The sidebar's hover-revealed control stays and stays primary; what goes is only the always-visible star in the page header. The page overflow entry is the same action for pages that have no sidebar item to hover (records; objects the app does not list).

**Scope extension (the proposal; same files, same card).** The hover-revealed control on a sidebar navigation item becomes a small ⋯ menu (also opened by right-click), and the star joins it as its first entry instead of being its own icon. Entries derive from the item's type, never from a product (ADR-0060): "Add to favorites" / "Remove from favorites"; "Open in new tab"; "Copy link"; and, only for a principal who may author metadata (`isAdmin && canAuthorMetadata`, the gate `PageView.openInStudio` already uses), a "Design" entry that opens the item's designer: a `page` item goes to `/apps/APP/metadata/page/NAME` exactly as `PageView.tsx` 129–132 does today, an `object` item to the object designer, a `dashboard` item to the dashboard designer (the dev finds each route in the console's metadata-admin router rather than from this comment). Items with no designer (`url`, `component`, `separator`) show no Design entry. The menu is one shared component for all item types; objectui#1055's rule (hover only, nothing permanently visible) carries over to the ⋯ trigger.

Acceptance adds: hovering a nav item shows one ⋯ trigger and no standalone pin icon; the menu for an `object` item lists exactly the four entries above for an admin and three for a non-admin; "Design" on the Leads item of the HotCRM demo lands on the object designer for `crm_lead`; right-click opens the same menu.

Maintainer direct-dispatch channel, verbatim authorisation (chat, 2026-10-15): 「按这个方案在 objectui 开一个 issue，使用 dispatch 技能，然后你负责派发开发。」 and the follow-ups quoted in the card and its addendum. Routing (`domain:ui`, `area:devpath`, `priority:p2`) was written by this seat under that channel; triage may regrade.

Scope note 2026-10-15T07:25Z from the dispatching seat (`session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP`, os-bill) on the dev report 6186752694 (status blocked, draft PR #12443 at `adb45f8`). The stop was right: the claim's surface did not reach the file that draws the control. Five decisions; the dev reads them with the card, the addendum and the claim.

1. **Surface extended** to `packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx` and one new test under `packages/layout/src/__tests__/`, with `@object-ui/layout` (published; no `private` key) added to the changeset as minor. Readings at this writing (2026-10-15T07:25Z): the governed-surface guard answers NOT GOVERNED for the path; no `origin/main` commit has touched the file since 2026-10-14; no in-flight `domain:ui` claim names it. Shape = the dev's option A: two additive props on `NavigationRendererProps` — a per-row slot the host fills, drawn in place of the pin `SidebarMenuAction` (lines 1559–1577 and 1625–1643 on `origin/main`), and host rows appended inside `favoritesSection` (line 1762), which then renders when either kind of row exists. A host passing neither keeps today's behaviour, the pinned drag order (objectui#12059) included. The existing tests that click "Pin NAME" by name are updated deliberately, as the report lists them.
2. **Design entries:** page, object and dashboard only (the addendum's enumeration); the dashboard designer is the metadata-admin route `metadata/dashboard/NAME`. Report and doc entries get no Design entry on this card.
3. **The merged section:** titled by `console.nav.favorites` (already Favorites / 收藏 with the star on `main`). A non-nav favorite row shows its stored label (the store's `refreshLabel` self-heals it) with its type icon, carries the same ⋯ menu, and its favorites entry removes it; Design shows for object, dashboard and page favorites derived from the id, never for a record or report favorite. `sidebar.favorites` becomes unread and leaves all ten packs; `sidebar.removeFromFavorites` stays for the console-home Starred group. The Favorites group drawn after Recent in `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` (the block around lines 524–530) is removed.
4. **Mobile:** no ⋯ trigger where `enablePinning` is off today; the objectui#1055 hover rule and today's mobile shape stand.
5. **Serial rule unchanged:** `ObjectView.tsx` and `RecordDetailView.tsx` only once `origin/main` carries #12436 (the same grep; #12436 has been in the merge queue since 2026-10-15T07:18Z with the queue CI running). Reached with 0 ⇒ the PR stays `Part of #12427` and the report says blocked on that one item; nothing else waits on it.

Resume-from: `claude/issue-12427-favorites-sidebar-menu@adb45f8` — same worktree, same branch, same draft PR #12443. When both halves are in, the PR body's first line becomes `Fixes #12427` (relay `issue_patch` on the pull's number, body otherwise kept) and the seat re-reads it before ready.
